result.topic_en: A grid table of quadratic residues, with prime moduli 191–433 as rows and primes 367–503 as columns; small circles mark entries and connecting lines join them into patterns.

methods.what: Tabulation of the quadratic residue relation between pairs of primes. A circle marks the pair (p,q), and lines connect the marked cells.
methods.quote: [Grid of small circles marking cells (row prime, column prime), connected by horizontal and vertical lines into chains and squares; no further text]
